modules.title: Team Assembly - Pack and Go Zip

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: A Pack and Go zip that opens with no missing references and holds the body, the blade and the three standard parts, with the standard parts unedited.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The zip opens, but a part is missing, a reference is broken, or a standard part has been edited.

levels.label: Developing
levels.short: Not a Pack and Go zip
levels.descriptor: A single file or loose files are uploaded instead of a Pack and Go zip, or the zip does not open.

levels.label: Complete
levels.short: Owned part, on template, material set
levels.descriptor: The .SLDPRT file for every part this student's role owns is uploaded, each is built on the template's construction sketch, and each has a material assigned.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.short: Part present, material or template missing
levels.descriptor: The owned part is uploaded, but it has no material assigned or is not built on the template's construction sketch.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A file is uploaded, but it is not a part this student's role owns, or it is not a .SLDPRT.

blocks.content:
### Sources

- IDEA-Blade Rulebook v3.0, sections 01 Design Specifications and 05 Inspection.
- IDEA100 Syllabus, Fall 2026, Project 4 IDEA-Blade.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: A .3mf for each printed part or a .dxf for each cut part this student owns, matching the part file uploaded above.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The file type is right for the process, but it does not match the current part file.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A file is uploaded, but it is the wrong type for the process.
